description: This file contains the implementation of an Orleans grain named ImplicitSubscriberGrain which subscribes to streams, handles stream events asynchronously, and tracks activity counters.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriberGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that subscribes implicitly to a stream, handles stream events, and maintains counters for requests and errors.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the specified counter ('requests' or 'errors').

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion notification; currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error notification; logs the error and increments the error counter.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items; logs the item if trace logging is enabled and increments the request counter.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles subscription setup; logs the subscription event, requests a counter grain to track this grain, and resumes the subscription handle.
